annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/78 establishing administrative provisions for the EC type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to their 112-based eCall in-vehicle systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/78 establishing administrative provisions for the EC type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to their 112-based eCall in-vehicle systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 12/26
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation setting administrative provisions for EC type-approval of vehicles, separate technical units and components with 112-based eCall in-vehicle systems, plus privacy and data-protection conditions: no tracking, automatic data deletion, security safeguards, and standardised user information. Not AI-specific.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturers apply to approval authorities for EC type-approval of vehicles, STUs and components using standard templates
eCall systems must not be traceable or subject to constant tracking in normal operation
Internal memory data must be continuously removed and unavailable externally before eCall trigger
Appropriate safeguards such as encryption must protect personal data
Owner's manual must include a standard data-processing information template; applies from 31 March 2018
